evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies AddrMan connection and address tracking logic in src/addrman.cpp and src/addrman_impl.h.
rationale: Fixes a bug where a local node losing reachability on one network (e.g. Tor or IPv6) while connected on another (IPv4) incorrectly marks valid remote peers as terrible and stops relaying them. As stratospher and naiyoma note in review, isolating `m_last_good` per network ensures local reachability failures do not penalize healthy remote addresses across networks.
